en.short_description: Suggested replies that sound like you. Runs on your device. No account, no ads.
en.description:
AGrammarly suggests replies to the messages you get, and it does the whole job on your phone.

—— How it works ——

Paste or type the message you received. AGrammarly offers three replies to choose from, each labelled: one casual, one professional, one short. Tap one to put it in your reply, adjust it if you like, then tap Copy and paste it into your messaging app. Long-press a suggestion to copy it straight away.

Suggestions come from a pattern set that ships inside the app, combined with the phrasings and emoji you use most. There is no model call and no suggestions server: the matching runs on the device, so it works with no signal at all.

—— It learns how you write ——

The more replies you copy into your messages, the more your own phrasing shows up in what it offers. Your most-used emoji move to the front. All of that is stored on your device, and Settings can delete every bit of it in one action.

—— A practice keyboard ——

The Keyboard tab is a full QWERTY layout inside AGrammarly with the suggestion bar above it, so you can try the flow and see the keystrokes it saves. It is a practice surface inside this app — AGrammarly does not install a system keyboard, so it does not appear in your keyboard list for use in other apps.

—— What it keeps ——

No account. No sign-up. No ads and no analytics. Nothing you type leaves the phone: this build ships with no suggestions service configured. Your learned style and your counters live on the device and nowhere else.

The one thing the app can send is a crash report. If AGrammarly crashes, Google Firebase Crashlytics receives the technical details of the crash and an anonymous installation ID, so the bug can be fixed. It does not include your messages or anything the app has learned.

—— Honest about what it is not ——

AGrammarly is a reply helper, not a grammar or spelling checker, and not a writing assistant powered by a language model. It suggests replies; it does not correct your text. Suggestions and the keyboard are in English only.

en.release_notes:
First release of AGrammarly.

• Three suggested replies for any message — casual, professional, short
• Copy a reply and paste it into any messaging app
• Matching runs on your device — works offline, no account
• Learns the phrases and emoji you actually use
• A practice keyboard with the suggestion bar, and a count of keystrokes saved
• Delete everything it has learned, in one action

review_information.notes:
2. DEVICES AND OS VERSIONS TESTED
Automated tests run on every build: iPhone 17 Pro Max and iPad Pro 13-inch simulators on iOS 26, and a Pixel Android emulator on API 34.
Each release is also installed and launched on those targets, so a
build that cannot start never ships.

3. WHAT THIS APP DOES, AND FOR WHOM
AGrammarly suggests replies to the messages you get, and it does the whole job on your phone.

Intended audience:
On-device reply suggestions

4. SETTING UP AND REACHING THE MAIN FEATURES
No account and no login are required. After the one-screen introduction, tap Start. On the Keyboard tab, type a message such as "thanks" into Incoming message: three labelled suggestions (casual, professional, short) appear above the keys. Tap one, then tap Copy to put the reply on the clipboard, or long-press a suggestion to copy it directly. Settings has the privacy policy, support and "Clear everything learned".

5. EXTERNAL SERVICES USED
- Google Firebase Crashlytics, for crash reports only (crash details and an anonymous installation ID; no user content).
- Firebase Analytics and Performance Monitoring are linked through a shared library but deactivated in Info.plist and AndroidManifest.xml and never started; no analytics are collected.
- The app has no backend, no account and no suggestions service. Privacy policy and support pages open in the browser.

6. REGIONAL DIFFERENCES
The app is English only: its suggestion patterns and keyboard are English, so the binary declares English as its only localization. Features are identical in every region.

7. REGULATED INDUSTRY OR THIRD-PARTY MATERIAL

The app is not in a regulated industry and carries no licensed third-party material. All content, artwork and copy are the developer's own.


ACCOUNT DELETION
The app creates no account, so there is nothing to delete.
